declaration_contract.not_applicable_interpretation: NOT_APPLICABLE is not added to CausalIdentificationStatus. The permitted case is ChildActionRecord.causal_contribution_ref equal to Applicability.NOT_APPLICABLE.
declaration_contract.validator_signature: (closure: SettlementClosureRecord, quote: Quote, receipt: Receipt, group_receipt: GroupReceipt, child_actions: tuple[ChildActionRecord,...], residual: GroupResidual, shares: tuple[SettlementShare,...], causal_status: CausalIdentificationStatus, /) -> None

current_conflict.current_causal_predicate: causal_status is not IDENTIFIED and (bool(shares) or closure.closure_resolution.state is PRESENT or any child.causal_contribution_ref is ObjectRef or any child.settlement_share_ref is ObjectRef)
current_conflict.effect: The current validator rejects independently authorized noncausal institutional shares, child settlement links, and present exact settlement closure.
current_conflict.current_closure_predicate: measured_total differs from share_total plus residual, or shares are empty while closure_resolution is PRESENT
current_conflict.closure_gap: The current validator does not separately establish that actual supplied share amounts sum to share_total or require PRESENT closure when shares are nonempty.

nonidentified.bypass_rule: Both directly supplied statuses must be IDENTIFIED before a causal contribution can be admitted.

causal_claim.expression: any(type(child.causal_contribution_ref) is ObjectRef for child in child_actions)
includes: institutional share or its evidence represented through a causal-contribution link

share_total.expression: residual.share_total == exact_sum(share.amount for share in shares in canonical order)

measured_closure.unit_precondition: all compared Quantity unit_ref and dimension_ref values are exactly equal

causal_failure.identified_empty_child_rule_preserved: causal_status == IDENTIFIED and not child_actions remains CAUSAL_ATTRIBUTION_UNRESOLVED

institutional_evidence_typing.rule: Settlement evidence must not be typed or described as causal-identification evidence unless both direct statuses are IDENTIFIED.
institutional_evidence_typing.i3_local_expression: A locally represented causal label requires an ObjectRef in child.causal_contribution_ref and is therefore covered by causal_claim.
institutional_evidence_typing.opaque_target_rule: No target role is inferred from SettlementShare.evidence_refs. External target typing must fail closed before acceptance if inconsistent.

physical_measurement.rule: Settlement may reference but may not mutate or replace the immutable physical group measurement.
physical_measurement.local_scope: GroupResidual.measured_total is compared arithmetically but is not computed or written.
physical_measurement.external_replacement_owner: existing identity or registry immutability boundary

validator_bypass.rule: Any path that omits validate_settlement_closure has no accepted settlement result.

allowed_combinations: UNIDENTIFIED with no causal claim and no settlement
UNIDENTIFIED with causal_contribution_ref NOT_APPLICABLE, institutional shares, valid rule_ref, compatible units, PRESENT closure, and exact zero residual
UNIDENTIFIED with causal_contribution_ref NOT_APPLICABLE, institutional shares, valid rule_ref, compatible units, PRESENT closure, and exact nonzero residual
PARTIALLY_IDENTIFIED under the same nonidentified causal prohibition with independently authorized settlement
NOT_APPLICABLE child causal-contribution field with independently authorized settlement
all historically accepted IDENTIFIED combinations whose unrelated predicates remain satisfied
rejected_combinations: numeric causal contribution under either nonidentified direct status
linked causal-contribution evidence under either nonidentified direct status
institutional share represented or linked as causal-identification evidence under either nonidentified direct status
well-formed rule_ref not independently accepted as institutional
settlement shares without explicit PRESENT residual closure
amount prohibited by an existing numeric or sign rule
settlement attempt to replace physical group measurement
